profile.description: Intel Corporation v CPM United Kingdom Ltd., case C-252/07, was a case of the European Court of Justice in which the ECJ interpreted the meaning of Article 4 (4)(a) of the EU Trade Marks Directive. The court considered what elements are required to show that a later mark was causing dilution to an earlier mark.
profile.description_zh: 英特尔公司诉CPM United Kingdom Ltd.案（C-252/07）是欧洲法院审理的一起案件，ECJ在该案中对欧盟商标指令第4条第4款(a)项的含义进行了解释。法院考量了证明在后商标对在先商标造成淡化所需具备的要件。
